newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mobilcom IPO over 100 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Mobilcom IPO over 100 times oversubscribed.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares in German mobile phone company Mobilcom AG was more than 100 times oversubscribed, chief executive Gerhard Schmid told Reuters on Monday.

The shares, which were offered to the public at 62.50 marks ($36.61), begin trade from 1100 GMT today on Germany's new growth stock index, dubbed Neue Markt or new market, which is modelled after the Nasdaq index of the United States.

The have already been traded in the so-called grey market in a range of 82-84 marks. On the grey market, investors may place orders with brokers ahead of time that are completed once shares officially begin.
The main underwriter for the share offering is co-operative bank DG Bank.
